text: That morning: Holmes remarks on the match and asks what the coroner concluded
why: Set that morning, Holmes does remark that the match shows she struck a light and looked about, and he asks what the coroner concluded.

text: Why did Julia strike a light? — a noise in the room alarmed her
id: q.why_match=a noise in the room alarmed her
why: The story has given reason to consider a noise: Julia spoke of a whistle, Helen heard a whistle and a clang, and Julia was a light sleeper. It is offered only as a possibility.

text: What was the speckled band that Julia cried out about? — she had struck a light and looked about her before she spoke of it
why: The story states that the match and match-box show she struck a light and looked about when the alarm took place, as Holmes says. The label does not claim what the speckled band is.
